Hello everyone, my name is John, and I’m a software developer based in New York. I have been working in the tech industry for about 5 years now, mostly focusing on web development and backend stuff. I started my career as an intern at a small startup where I really got the hang of coding, and since then I’ve been hooked.

Currently, I’m working at a mid-sized company where I’m responsible for managing and improving our main web app. I have good experience with JavaScript, Python, and a bit of DevOps too. I’m always looking for new opportunities to learn and grow my skillset.

Outside of work, I enjoy playing video games, reading sci-fi novels, and hiking. I’m also a bit of a foodie, so I love exploring new restaurants in the city. Looking forward to getting to know everyone here!
